notes: Inspected the fresh 1536x1024 capture from Whole-product QA evidence run 33572364279 at commit 9e91511c12ad9a3e727e3fa56e15b7197de191d2. This capture differs substantially from alpha.5's, as alpha.6 rebuilds the review panel. What the frame shows and what I checked: evidence now reads as attributed quotations under labelled DATE, TYPE, and PARTIES headings, with each party on its own line so it can be checked separately, rather than the previous run-together definition list; the model's confidence appears in the panel with an exact percentage beside a proportional track, on the surface where the trust decision is actually made; the approve and keep actions sit in a pinned bar at the foot of the panel; the selected row carries an accent bar as well as a tint, so it is no longer confusable with hover; and a help affordance sits beside the settings gear. Hierarchy, alignment, and spacing hold across all three planes. Statuses remain distinguishable by icon as well as colour, and this run's automated contrast assertions passed. No clipping, collisions, illegible copy, or ambiguous focus. The proposed filename is set in a monospace face on purpose: it is a string that will exist on disk verbatim, and mono is what makes a doubled space visible while it can still be corrected. Scope is a rendered fidelity review of the web build, not a pixel-equality claim; native title bar, 1024 layout, hover, and motion rely on the automated and installed-app gates, which passed in this run.
